topic: Music players: from the gramophone to wireless earbuds

episode.title: From Gramophone to Wireless Earbuds

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a horn gramophone, centered on a seamless pale gray gradient background, vertical 9:16. Fixed front three-quarter view from slightly above, soft upper-left lighting, subtle floor shadow. Polished wooden base, large brass horn, blank black record. No people, text, l
shots.action: Show the music-playing device stationary, its front facing slightly right. Make the oversized brass horn the defining feature. Preserve this camera angle, lighting, and centered staging throughout the sequence.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a compact tabletop record player, centered on a seamless pale gray gradient background, vertical 9:16. Fixed front three-quarter view from slightly above, soft upper-left lighting, subtle floor shadow. Wooden cabinet, open lid, blank black vinyl record and tonearm.
shots.action: Flash-cut replacement at the same center point. The defining change is the horn replaced by a compact cabinet with an integrated speaker; keep the record clearly visible.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a tabletop cassette player, centered on a seamless pale gray gradient background, vertical 9:16. Fixed front three-quarter view from slightly above, soft upper-left lighting, subtle floor shadow. Simple rectangular body, clear cassette window showing two tape spool
shots.action: Flash-cut replacement at the same center point. Make the switch from an exposed record to an enclosed cassette the single dominant visual change.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a pocket-sized portable cassette player, centered on a seamless pale gray gradient background, vertical 9:16. Fixed front three-quarter view from slightly above, soft upper-left lighting, subtle floor shadow. Compact rectangular body, clear cassette window showing
shots.action: Flash-cut replacement at the same center point and camera scale. Retain the recognizable cassette window; make the reduction to a pocket-sized body the defining change.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a portable CD player, centered on a seamless pale gray gradient background, vertical 9:16. Fixed front three-quarter view from slightly above, soft upper-left lighting, subtle floor shadow. Slim circular silver body, transparent closed lid revealing a reflective co
shots.action: Flash-cut replacement at the same center point. Make the circular disc format replacing the rectangular cassette format the single dominant visual change.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of an unbranded pocket digital music player, centered on a seamless pale gray gradient background, vertical 9:16. Fixed front three-quarter view from slightly above, soft upper-left lighting, subtle floor shadow. Small brushed-silver rectangular body, dark blank scree
shots.action: Flash-cut replacement at the same center point and camera scale. Make the disappearance of physical music media into a tiny solid-state device the defining visual change.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of wireless earbuds seated in an open charging case, presented as one centered product on a seamless pale gray gradient background, vertical 9:16. Fixed front three-quarter view from slightly above, soft upper-left lighting, subtle floor shadow. Sculpted pearl-white s
shots.action: Flash-cut replacement at the same center point. Make the transformation from a separate handheld player to miniature wireless listening hardware the defining change. Finish with a pristine hero image emphasizing the earbuds and their sculpted case.

episode.endHook: Which one was your first music player?
